name: Simple AutoFish
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: MVPFishstock
description: A Mod that automatically reels in fish and recasts your fishing rod when a fish bites. Perfect for AFK fishing!

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Auto fishing: with a fishing rod in hand it reels in when the bobber dips (a bite) and casts again; the Up arrow key (default code 82) toggles it and says 'Auto Fish: Enabled' / 'Auto Fish: Disabled' in chat.
note: Not yet: The steps check its toggle key and message; the reeling itself needs water, a cast rod and a random fish bite, which a short try can't wait for.
